notes: Separate article counts cover requests recorded since this feature was enabled, with no historical backfill. Research totals refer to /research.html, including Article 1 before that URL became the research index.
An article dash (—) means no retained count, not a measured zero. It can include dates before separate article recording began; neither a dash nor the first record establishes activation time.
Missing dates are omitted, not filled with zeros. A zero cell means no retained count for that page on a date with other recorded requests; it does not prove uninterrupted measurement.
